highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and the Skia m152 engine.
highlights_body: This release also expands native package support, improves memory safety and allocation behavior, and refreshes the renderer with upstream servicing updates.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone m152 and incorporates upstream m151 and m152 servicing changes.
Adds managed bindings for Skia's Graphite backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
SKImage and SKSurface now offer backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs.
SKRegion iteration, SKPixmap subsets and derived pixmaps now retain their native sources for as long as consumers can use them.
SKImage.Create now releases its pixel buffer when raster-image creation fails.

bullets.lead: Runtime-effect uniform buffers are released on reset
bullets.detail: Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms now disposes the previous uniform buffer instead of retaining native memory.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz blob conversion releases temporary streams
bullets.detail: Converting non-memory-backed SKStreamAsset instances to HarfBuzz blobs no longer retains the temporary stream.

bullets.lead: Native symbols and Vulkan package availability expanded
bullets.detail: Apple native symbol packages are produced during packing, Android symbols have deterministic identities, and the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package is available again.
Nano Server uses FreeType for font support, enabling text rendering on that Windows container platform.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved the Windows native-build environment initialization
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, the Skia m152 engine update, and native package support improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added renderer servicing updates, native-symbol packaging, and lifecycle fixes for uniform buffers and HarfBuzz stream conversion.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzzSharp shaping and tag-formatting performance while refining package documentation and cross-platform packaging.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel reads.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also updates the bundled renderer to Skia m152 and broadens native platform support.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 adds renderer servicing and package-delivery improvements.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It also includes native-resource lifecycle fixes and deterministic native-symbol packaging.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 delivers Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and the Skia m152 renderer.
v4.152.0.body: The stable release includes upstream renderer servicing, native package support improvements, and resource-lifetime fixes.
